title: Config Sync groups file (legacy, pre-schema-v2)
description: The hand-edited groups file at <data folder>/config-sync.json. Config Sync no longer WRITES this file — since settings schema v2 the sync list is compiled from the plugin's own data.json (`items` + `customGroups`) — but `validateSyncManifest` still reads and validates one, so a vault that predates v2, or a rule set kept by hand, is described here. This schema mirrors that validator; the validator is the authority.

path.description: Vault-relative path; {configDir} expands to this device's config dir

description.description: Human-readable label for this group, shown in the settings panel

mode.description: Sync mode. Absent = "plain". "fields" (file groups only) applies per-key rules; "encrypted" encrypts the whole file.

fileRule.description: Whole-file rule for a Plain single-file group. Never valid with "mode": "fields" or "encrypted".

perItem.description: Per-element scopes for string-array keys: key name -> { element value -> scope }. Only valid with "mode": "fields"; a key listed here can never also be encrypted.

label.description: Display name recorded when the item is enabled or captured; shown even where the plugin isn't installed.

origin.description: Set by the plugin for rules created from the Discovered-files section; name and path are fixed by the file.

else.description: "perItem" needs "mode": "fields" — otherwise the per-element scopes never take effect.

then.description: A whole-file rule belongs to a Plain group; "fields"/"encrypted" carry their own rules.

scope.description: Where the value is shared: every device, one device class (each class keeping its own value in a __scopes__ sidecar), or "local" — never leaves this device and never enters the store.

fieldRule.description: Scope and encryption are independent axes, not one action enum. (Before schema v2 this was {"pattern", "action": "strip"|"encrypt"}; that shape is no longer accepted.)

locked.description: Preset rule injected by the plugin; cannot be removed in the UI.

not.description: A value that never leaves this device has nothing to encrypt for transit.

scope.description: No "local": a Plain file that should not travel is expressed by the group's own sync toggle.
